prompts.name: Oak
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production-ready 2D tree sprite for Unity, in the hand-drawn storybook fantasy RPG Aurenfeld. One isolated complete tree on a genuinely transparent background. Three-quarter front view, almost orthographic, compatible with upright billboard art in a gently elevated camera. Warm brown confident ink contours, subtle watercolor/gouache paper grain, simplified elegant cel-shaded painted forms like illustrated paper RPG characters, clean sharp edges, hand-drawn NOT pixel art, NOT photorealistic, NOT a 3D render. Rich natural green foliage, warm honey light from upper left, cool green shadow masses, warm chestnut wood. Distinctive irregular natural silhouette, botanical identity readable at small screen sizes. Thin restrained cream edge directly around the silhouette only, no thick sticker border. Whole crown, branches and trunk base visible, short roots, trunk base centered horizontally, transparent padding on all sides. No scenery, ground slab, landscape, grass patch, text, labels, frame, cast shadow, glow or checkerboard painted in. One tree only, no asset sheet. A broad old field oak: asymmetrical wide spreading crown, powerful curved trunk with branching limbs visible between five large foliage masses, small lobed oak leaf accents, mature welcoming character. Broad rather than tall; substantially different from a symmetrical three-puff lollipop tree.

backgroundEdit: Use case: background-extraction. This is an edit target, not a style reference. Keep this exact illustrated tree, its species, shape, colors, ink lines, branches and roots. Remove ALL the blurry colored halo, gradient, glow and backdrop surrounding the tree and inside the holes between branches. Outside actual leaves, wood and their very thin cream contour must be 100% transparent alpha=0, including every gap between branches. Interior leaves and trunk must remain fully opaque. Clean antialiased silhouette, no red/green/yellow matte fringes, no atmosphere, no ground, no painted black background. Preserve entire tree without clipping, add a small transparent safety margin at the edges. Deliver one genuinely transparent production sprite for a game.
note: Oak and Birch use the second generation (background extraction edit). Apple and Willow use the first generation. Original files retained in Codex generated_images.
